changes.title: Fewer stalls
items: Fewer hitches in play: the game's shaders are all made ready while the forest grows, not the first time you rise, land or come near something new
Legend carvings are made in quiet moments, not the moment you first fly near one

changes.title: Quest on drop
items: A quest finishes the moment you put the right sigil down in the legend's circle; the animal walks over afterwards
Put the wrong animal's sigil down in the circle and the panel tells you straight away what it wants instead

changes.title: World not remembered
items: The map's size and the fight's speed are no longer remembered from an earlier visit: every game starts with the real map and balance unless the link says otherwise (a 14 by 14 map had been sticking around in one browser)
